description:
Save recipes from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and the web.

Paste a link and MainCourse turns it into a clean, structured recipe: ingredients, steps, prep time, servings. Browse them anytime, even offline.

Plan your week
Drag recipes onto a weekly meal plan. See what you're cooking at a glance.

Auto-built shopping list
Add recipe ingredients to the shopping list.

Cook together
Share a cookbook with family or roommates. Everyone can add recipes, edit the meal plan, and use the shopping list.

Capture anything
Photograph a page from a cookbook or a handwritten note and it gets imported the same way.

Built for how you actually save recipes
– One-paste import from TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, and any recipe website
– Share sheet support: import from Safari or social apps without switching
– Full offline access to your saved recipes
– Search by name or ingredient.
– Adjust recipe details, edit ingredients, add notes

Free to start. Subscribe for unlimited imports.

whatsNew:
Sign in with Apple and Google
You can now create an account or sign in with Apple or Google, so there is no password to remember. Existing email and password accounts keep working exactly as before.

Plus bug fixes and improvements.
